title: Karura Forest Community 10K Run
subtitle: A scenic 10 km and 5 km run through Karura Forest trails
description: Run or walk 5 km or 10 km on shaded forest trails. All fitness levels are welcome, with water points along the route and a cool-down session at the finish.
fullContent: The Karura Forest Community Run brings runners, walkers and families together for a morning on the forest trails. Choose the 5 km fun run or the 10 km route. Timing is provided for the 10 km category, and every finisher gets a medal. Arrive early for bib collection and the group warm-up.

venue.name: Karura Forest, Main Gate
venue.mapNote: Bib collection opens at the Limuru Road gate from 06:00. Limited parking inside the forest.

tiers.name: Standard Entry
tiers.description: Race bib, timing for the 10 km and finisher medal.

tiers.name: Entry + Race Kit
tiers.description: Everything in Standard Entry plus a race T-shirt and cap.

host.name: Trail Runners KE
host.bio: A volunteer running club organizing community trail runs around Nairobi.

title: Nairobi Sounds Live
subtitle: Benga, Afro-pop and Gengetone on one stage
description: An evening of live Kenyan music featuring upcoming artists and a closing DJ set. Food and drinks are available on site.
fullContent: Nairobi Sounds Live celebrates the range of Kenyan music, from classic benga to Afro-pop and Gengetone. Four live acts perform back to back, followed by a DJ set. Food vendors and a bar are open throughout. Gates close at 22:00; entry is 18+ after 21:00.

venue.name: Kenya National Theatre Grounds
venue.mapNote: Use the Harry Thuku Road entrance. Ride-hailing drop-off at the main gate.

tiers.name: VIP
tiers.description: Seated VIP area near the stage with a dedicated bar.

host.name: Mtaa Live Events
host.bio: Mtaa Live Events produces live music shows that showcase Kenyan talent.

title: SME Growth Summit Nairobi
subtitle: Financing, digital sales and export readiness for small businesses
description: A one-day summit for small and medium business owners with talks on access to finance, selling online and growing into regional markets.
fullContent: The SME Growth Summit brings business owners together with lenders, digital platforms and experienced founders. Sessions cover preparing for a loan, using mobile payments and online marketplaces, and the paperwork for exporting within the East African Community. The day ends with a networking session.

venue.name: Sarit Expo Centre
venue.mapNote: Parking available at Sarit Centre. Delegates register at Hall A.

tiers.name: Delegate
tiers.description: Full-day access to all sessions, lunch and networking.

tiers.name: Exhibitor Booth
tiers.description: A 3 m × 3 m booth to show your products, plus two delegate passes.

host.name: Biashara Hub
host.bio: Biashara Hub runs trainings and events for Kenyan small business owners.

agenda.title: Opening keynote: Growing beyond your county
Workshop: Selling online with mobile payments

title: Nairobi Dev Meetup: Building with Mobile Money APIs
subtitle: Hands-on session on integrating mobile payments into your apps
description: A free evening meetup for developers covering payment APIs, callbacks and testing, with a live coding demo and Q&A.
fullContent: This month’s Nairobi Dev Meetup is about integrating mobile money payments. We walk through STK push flows, handling callbacks securely and testing in a sandbox, then open the floor for questions. Bring a laptop if you want to follow along.

venue.name: Westlands Innovation Space
venue.mapNote: Take the lift to the 4th floor. Wi-Fi details at the door.

tiers.name: Free Entry
tiers.description: Free registration. Please register so we can plan seating.

host.name: Nairobi Dev Community
host.bio: A volunteer-run community of software developers meeting monthly in Nairobi.

agenda.title: Talk: How mobile payment APIs work

title: Youth Career & Internship Fair
subtitle: Meet employers offering internships, graduate jobs and apprenticeships
description: Bring your CV and meet employers from banking, tech, manufacturing and the public sector. CV clinics and mock interviews run all day.
fullContent: The Youth Career & Internship Fair connects students and recent graduates with employers looking for interns and entry-level staff. Visit employer stands, get your CV reviewed, practise interviews and attend short talks on job hunting. Entry is free but registration is required.

venue.name: KICC, Tsavo Ballroom
venue.mapNote: Enter through the Harambee Avenue gate with your registration code.

tiers.name: Free Entry
tiers.description: Free registration for students and graduates.

host.name: Ajira Careers Network
host.bio: Ajira Careers Network helps young Kenyans find internships and first jobs.

agenda.title: Talk: Writing a CV that gets interviews

title: Swahili Arts & Food Festival
subtitle: Taarab, crafts and coastal cuisine in Old Town Mombasa
description: A day celebrating Swahili culture with taarab music, henna and craft stalls, poetry and coastal food.
fullContent: Spend the day in Mombasa’s Old Town exploring Swahili art, music and food. Local artisans sell crafts, chefs serve coastal dishes, and taarab musicians and poets perform through the afternoon and evening.

venue.name: Fort Jesus Grounds
venue.mapNote: Walk in from Nkrumah Road. Tuk-tuks drop off near the main entrance.

tiers.name: Family Pass (4 people)
tiers.description: Entry for up to four people.

host.name: Pwani Arts Collective
host.bio: Pwani Arts Collective supports artists and cultural events on the Kenyan coast.

title: Kisumu Lakeshore Clean-Up & Tree Planting
subtitle: Help clean the Lake Victoria shoreline and plant 1,000 trees
description: A free volunteer morning cleaning the lakeshore and planting indigenous trees. Gloves, bags and seedlings are provided.
fullContent: Join neighbours, students and local groups for a morning of community action at Dunga Beach. Volunteers will collect litter along the shoreline and plant indigenous seedlings nearby. Wear closed shoes and bring a water bottle.

venue.name: Dunga Beach
venue.mapNote: Meet at the beach management unit office.

host.name: Green Lake Kisumu
host.bio: A community group working to keep Kisumu’s lakeshore clean and green.

title: County Budget Public Participation Forum
subtitle: Have your say on next year’s county budget priorities
description: A public forum where residents can review the draft budget priorities and give feedback on health, roads, water and markets.
fullContent: This forum gives Nakuru residents a chance to understand the draft county budget and share their views. Facilitators will explain the proposed priorities, and residents can speak or submit written comments. Entry is free and open to all residents.

host.name: Civic Voices Kenya
host.bio: Civic Voices Kenya runs civic education and public participation sessions.

title: Nairobi Pet Adoption Day
subtitle: Meet rescued cats and dogs looking for a home
description: Meet rescued animals, talk to vets about pet care and adopt a new companion. Entry fees support the rescue shelters.
fullContent: Several animal rescue groups bring cats and dogs that are ready for adoption. Vets will be on hand for free pet-care advice, and there are activities for children. Adoption follows each shelter’s screening process.

tiers.name: Entry
tiers.description: General entry. Proceeds support the shelters.

host.name: Paws Rescue Nairobi
host.bio: Paws Rescue Nairobi rehomes rescued cats and dogs across the city.

title: Lake Region Climate Tech Hackathon
subtitle: 48 hours to build solutions for farmers and fishers
description: Teams of developers, designers and domain experts build climate tools for the Lake Victoria region. Free to join; mentors and meals provided.
fullContent: Form a team or join one on the day, then spend the weekend building practical climate tools for farmers and fishing communities around Lake Victoria. Mentors support each team and the best projects present to a panel on Sunday.

venue.name: Kisumu Innovation Centre
venue.mapNote: Bring a laptop and charger. Meals are provided.

host.name: Lake Region Tech Hub
host.bio: A community supporting developers and startups in Western Kenya.
